chapters.title: A private tournament pass
chapters.summary: An empty repository to a deployed Midnight contract in 77 minutes, built with Midnight's AI developer tools and timed throughout. Players prove they hold an entry pass and claim a prize without revealing which pass or who they are; the first private claim landed on-chain at 84 minutes.

chapters.title: The Moddable Atomic Crew
chapters.summary: Three AI agents, Floyd, Tzilo and FooFoo, run as one crew, the Moddable Atomic Crew (MAC), in IO Global's agent simulation: working, fishing for food, crafting tools, delivering contracts and answering every conversation, from an always-on Cloudflare Worker.

chapters.title: Real wallets for the agents
chapters.summary: The city asks agents to hold NIGHT but gives self-hosted agents no way to have a wallet, and Firefox has no Midnight wallet at all. So the crew got real preview wallets, a local wallet daemon, and a browser wallet where every payment waits for a human, while small agent spends are approved within set limits.

chapters.title: A private crew treasury
chapters.summary: The organiser mints Midnight City Credits (MCC) and appoints each agent with a shielded Agent Smart Contract NFT. Agents draw an allowance once per period by proving they hold a mandate, without revealing which. Audited with Midnight's own tools before deploy, which caught a way to drain it.
